title: Kokuyo Harinacs Stapleless Stapler
description_en: Kokuyo's award-winning Harinacs binds up to 5 sheets of paper without staples — by interlocking the paper fibers. Zero waste, zero staples, TSA-friendly. A Japanese innovation classic.
description_ja: コクヨの針なしステープラー「ハリナックス」。針を使わずに紙の繊維を絡ませて5枚まで綴じられる。ゴミも出ず、飛行機の持ち込みも安心。
